author: Climate Town
description: Are you a fossil fuel company that just had a massive, toxic gas leak? Well, you're in luck, because you might just get away with it scot-free. The current enforcement system leaves a lot to be desired, but there are a few groups out there using satellite data and analysis to hold polluters accountable. Go check them out right now over at biggaspolluters.org, earthworks.org, mrm.psehealthyenergy.org
title: Massive, Toxic Gas Leak? No Problem!
